status: M0 plan for the new OfficeIMO front-door package (no project exists yet; NuGet ID registered with two unlisted 0.1.x versions from 2022).

notes: Word.Html and Markdown.Html bring OfficeIMO.Html + AngleSharp; include them so the front door keeps HTML import and Markdown raw-HTML fidelity (Word.Markdown no longer references Word.Html).
Reader.All brings 31 reader handlers; the design's front door includes Reader with its format handlers (design: Packages).
Workflows is not referenced: it brings Invoicing, Project, OCR, Visio, DjVu, CHM, EPUB, Email and stays a Tier 2 package; its conversion and batch core moves into the front door.

publicTypes: OfficeConverter (static): Convert(string source, string destination, OfficeConversionOptions options = null) : OfficeConversionReport; Convert(Stream source, OfficeDocumentFormat sourceFormat, Stream destination, OfficeDocumentFormat target, OfficeConversionOptions options = null); ConvertAsync(...) twins; ConvertAsync(IEnumerable<string> sources, string outputDirectory, OfficeDocumentFormat target, OfficeBatchOptions options = null) : Task<OfficeBatchReport>; Analyze(string source, string destination, OfficeConversionOptions options = null) : OfficeConversionReport (proposed); Register(IOfficeConversionRoute route) (proposed, for Tier 2 routes)
OfficeDocumentFormat (existing Core enum: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown, Pdf, Html, ...) names formats; there is no new OfficeDocumentFormat enum (design: Packages)

OfficeConversionOptions: target-specific option bags (Word = WordPdfExportOptions, ...), FailOnLoss, conflict policy, limits; replaces OfficeWorkflowConversionOptions and Word/Excel/PowerPoint *DocumentConversionOptions

OfficeBatchOptions: MaxParallelism, ResumeFrom, OutputDirectory, Recursive, Extensions, ConflictPolicy, limits, Load/Save (JSON job file); replaces OfficeConversionJob, OfficeConversionBatchRequest and builder state
OfficeBatchReport / OfficeBatchItemReport: per-item OfficeConversionReport, totals, elapsed, resume state; replaces OfficeConversionBatchResult/Report and OfficeConversionJobRunReport
OfficeDocument (static): Inspect(string path, OfficeInspectOptions options = null) for any format (design: Lifecycle)
absorbs: OfficeIMO.Workflows Batches/ and ConversionJobs/ (checkpointing, resume, publication guard) - net10.0 only, no netstandard2.0 port (design: Packages)
*ToPdfBytes helpers in Word, PowerPoint, Excel.Pdf (and Tier 2 *.Pdf adapters: 400 files call ToPdfBytes, mostly tests)

conflicts: Resolved (design: Packages): the OfficeIMO namespace holds Core's shared types plus OfficeConverter and the batch types; Core does not move to OfficeIMO.Core.
Resolved (design: Packages): OfficeColor and OfficeColorRole move from OfficeIMO.Drawing into the OfficeIMO namespace with the other shared foundations.
Resolved (design: Packages): the existing Core OfficeDocumentFormat enum names formats; no OfficeDocumentFormat enum is added.
openQuestions: Decided (design: Packages): the OfficeIMO front door targets net10.0 only; .NET Framework applications reference the format and adapter packages, which target netstandard2.0 and net10.0. Still open: each #if NETFRAMEWORK workaround in those packages needs a runtime-check replacement proved on .NET Framework 4.7.2.
